title: Wireless firmware versions MR 32.1.3 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new beta wireless firmware is now available on Thu, 31 Jul 2025

Important note: MR45/55 APs are not supported on MR 32.x.x and will instead upgrade to the backup version (MR 31.1.7.1) if they are in networks configured for MR 32.x.x versions, and thus, new features will not be available.
Bug fixes: General stability, performance, and experience improvements
APs do not send beacon frames on 5GHz radio (Wi-Fi 7 APs)
MAC auth fails with RADIUS servers that do not supply Message-Authenticator in Access-Accept reply (Wi-Fi 6, 6e, 7 APs)

html:
Wireless firmware versions MR 32.1.3 changelog

Important note

  • MR45/55 APs are not supported on MR 32.x.x and will instead upgrade to the backup version (MR 31.1.7.1) if they are in networks configured for MR 32.x.x versions, and thus, new features will not be available.

Bug fixes

  • General stability, performance, and experience improvements
  • APs do not send beacon frames on 5GHz radio (Wi-Fi 7 APs)
  • MAC auth fails with RADIUS servers that do not supply Message-Authenticator in Access-Accept reply (Wi-Fi 6, 6e, 7 APs)
